mapper.sql: SELECT u.account_id, u.user_id, u.site_id, (select sub.site_name from site_info sub where u.site_id = sub.site_id) as site_name, u.user_email, u.username, u.profile_color, u.profile_initials, u.user_role, u.account_status, u.password_reset_required, u.phone_number, u.created_by, u.created_at, u.created_ip, u.updated_by, u.updated_at, u.updated_ip FROM user_account u
mapper.select: ORDER BY CASE u.account_status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 0 WHEN 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 WHEN 'DISABLED' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, u.created_at DESC, u.user_id

sql.if: AND ( LOWER(u.user_id) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%') OR LOWER(u.username) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%') OR LOWER(u.user_email) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%') OR LOWER(u.site_id) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE((SELECT s.site_name FROM site_info s WHERE s.site_id = u.site_id), '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_site_access usa JOIN site_info s ON s.site_id = usa.site_id WHERE usa.account_id = u.account_id AND ( LOWER(usa.site_id) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.site_name, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%') ) ) )

mapper.select:
WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY CASE u.account_status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 0 WHEN 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 WHEN 'DISABLED' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, u.created_at DESC, u.user_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_account u WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT u.account_status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM user_account u WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY u.account_status

SELECT u.account_id, u.user_id, u.site_id, u.username, u.profile_color, u.profile_initials, u.user_email, u.user_role, u.account_status, u.password_hash, u.password_changed_at, u.password_reset_required FROM user_account u WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT l.login_id, l.user_id, l.password_error_count, l.created_by, l.created_at, l.created_ip, l.updated_by, l.updated_at, l.updated_ip FROM user_login_attempt l WHERE l.login_id = #{loginId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_login_attempt ( login_id, user_id, password_error_count, created_by, created_ip, updated_by, updated_ip ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{userId}, 0, 'ANONYMOUS', /* login 시도 시에는 user_id 식별불가 */ #{createdIp}, 'ANONYMOUS', /* login 시도 시에는 user_id 식별불가 */ #{updatedIp} )

INSERT INTO user_account ( user_id, site_id, user_email, username, profile_color, profile_initials, account_status, password_hash, password_changed_at, password_reset_required, phone_number, user_role, created_by, created_ip, updated_by, updated_ip ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{siteId}, #{userEmail}, #{username}, #{profileColor}, #{profileInitials}, #{accountStatus}, #{passwordHash}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{passwordResetRequired}, #{phoneNumber}, #{userRole}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp} )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_account SET username = #{username}, user_email = #{userEmail}, site_id = #{siteId}, user_role = #{userRole}, account_status = 'ACTIVE', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_ip = #{updatedIp} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND account_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE user_account SET username = #{username}, user_email = #{userEmail}, site_id = #{siteId}, user_role = #{userRole}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_ip = #{updatedIp} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND account_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'DISABLED')

UPDATE user_account SET username = #{username}, user_email = #{userEmail}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, profile_color = #{profileColor}, profile_initials = #{profileInitials}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_ip = #{updatedIp} WHERE user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE user_account SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, password_changed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, password_reset_required = false, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_ip = #{updatedIp} WHERE user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE user_account SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, password_changed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, password_reset_required = true, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_ip = #{updatedIp} WHERE user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE user_account SET account_status = 'DISABLED', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_ip = #{updatedIp} WHERE site_id = #{siteId} AND user_role <> 'SUPER' AND account_status <> 'DISABLED'
mapper.select: SELECT site_id FROM user_site_access WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY site_id
mapper.sql: SELECT usa.account_id, s.site_id, s.site_name, s.site_enabled FROM user_site_access usa JOIN site_info s ON s.site_id = usa.site_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_site_access ( account_id, site_id, created_by, created_ip ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{siteId}, COALESCE(#{createdBy}, 'SYSTEM'), COALESCE(#{createdIp}, '0.0.0.0') ) ON CONFLICT (account_id, site_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO user_site_access ( account_id, site_id, created_by, created_ip ) VALUES
( #{accountId}, #{siteId}, COALESCE(#{createdBy}, 'SYSTEM'), COALESCE(#{createdIp}, '0.0.0.0') )
ON CONFLICT (account_id, site_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE user_account u SET site_id = ( SELECT usa.site_id FROM user_site_access usa WHERE usa.account_id = u.account_id ORDER BY usa.site_id LIMIT 1 ), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE u.site_id = #{siteId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_site_access usa WHERE usa.account_id = u.account_id )
mapper.select: SELECT k.account_id, a.user_id FROM user_api_key k JOIN user_account a ON k.account_id = a.account_id WHERE api_key = #{apiKey} AND valid_until >= current_timestamp AND enabled = true AND expired_at is null
